manifest.purpose: The single submission answer file for the analysis_report domain. It must be valid JSON with exactly three fields: locked (boolean), key_bits (string), and key_gates (array of strings). For this negative-control task the netlist contains no key-gate logic, so locked must be false, key_bits must be the empty string "", and key_gates must be the empty array []. This satisfies all functional requirements (FR1-FR4) and security requirements (SR1-SR2) by correctly reporting no locking structures and no recovered key.
